summary: The workflow is generated and verified inside the guard packages from a canonical YAML template with few stable variables, without a JSON DSL, and required-checks.json stays an independent machine authority.
rationale: Plan section 2.1 requires activation files to be generated and verified before installation, while the current workflow is only 285 lines, so a general DSL would cost more than it saves. The template checker validates public command use, base-worktree entry points and required-check names including matrix expansion. Plan 06 sections 10 and 17 D11; review sections 3, 6.7 and 7.2.
